Model did not describe the terminal-settlement mechanism (that Close settles even with unauctioned lots) or relate it to play; it simply closed after resolving lots without explaining that rule.

Model did not articulate that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission or any mechanism substituting objectives; it only noted buying was unavailable while a bid is pending and gave bid intents.
